title: Skalman extension brokered storage values
description: The wire values exchanged on /v1/storage when the host writes an extension's private storage on its behalf. This is what the supported runner uses; the experimental sandbox-exec launcher grants directories instead and these values never appear.

jsonValue.description: Any JSON value. The SDK models this as ExtensionJSONValue.

keyValueKey.description: One key-value key. UTF-8 encoding is capped at 512 bytes and control characters are rejected by the host.

keyValueSnapshot.description: The whole store, returned by GET /v1/storage/kv. It is fetched in one call because the store is capped at 1 MiB.

cacheName.description: One cache entry name. It is a single path component: no separators, not '.' or '..', and no control characters. Both the SDK and the host enforce this, because the host takes the name from a request body.

cacheEntry.description: The body of GET /v1/storage/cache/{name}. A null value is a cache miss, which is an ordinary answer rather than an error: Skalman may reclaim any entry at any moment.

value.description: Opaque bytes, at most 4 MiB after base64 decoding.
Opaque bytes, at most 4 MiB after base64 decoding. The extension's cache is additionally capped at 100 MiB in total, checked on every write.
